title: Radial Mirror Scattering and the QNM Convergence Region
summary: We revisit the convergence region of the quasinormal modes expansion of Schwarzschild retarded Green functions from a radial scattering viewpoint. The tortoise coordinate admits a natural reflection about a distinguished point, which maps the original Regge-Wheeler problem to a mirror radial problem with the same quasinormal mode spectrum. Although this reflection is not a spacetime symmetry and does not leave the potential invariant, it gives a simple image interpretation of the second lightcone distance that controls convergence.
